_README: Machine-readable voice rules. One per client (or one for AIS itself) at engagements/<slug>/voice-profile.json. This is the file agents load; voice-system-prompt.md is generated from it, and voice-of-brand.md is the human explanation. Doctrine lives in agents/16-sample-voice-locking.md — read that first.

sample_lock._note: Below 16 curated samples the output is generic. Do not ship voice-dependent work until locked is true. Samples live in engagements/<slug>/voice-samples/ with a manifest.

register._formality_options: sl: vi | ti. Getting this wrong in Slovene is the single most visible voice failure.
register._scale: 1–5. Measure these off the 16 samples, do not guess them.
register.hedging: hedge real uncertainty explicitly, never hedge a fact

lexicon._domain_terms_note: Term -> the exact way this subject says it. e.g. 'ponudba' not 'oferta'. Pull from the samples.
lexicon._banned_claims_note: Things that are not true and must never be written even if they would help. See feedback: no fabricated credentials.

punctuation._emoji_note: Set a small explicit palette only if the samples actually contain emoji. For regulated B2B this is almost always 'none'.
punctuation.numbers: Slovenian locale — comma decimals (305,50 €), space thousands separator

structure.opener: state the finding, not the greeting
structure._answer_first_note: Definitive answer in the first 40–60 words. Doubles as GEO structure — see sales/geo-aeo-strategy.md.
structure.evidence: every claim carries a number, a source, or a named example
structure.closer: one concrete next step with an owner

people._note: Sub-profiles where a named person's voice differs from the house voice. Each needs its own 16.

refusals._note: What this voice declines to do, in its own words.

review.drift_check: Sample 10 recent outputs against 3 locked samples. If a stranger can't tell they're the same author, re-lock.
